issues.spec_citation: SQL-on-FHIR v2.0.0 ViewDefinition.select.column.type: the field is a FHIR StructureDefinition URI; implementations should report an error if returned type does not match the declared type, or if a non-primitive type is returned while type is unset.
issues.evidence: Fresh probe `.temp/qa/sof_vd04_historian_probe.py` showed native execution accepted `code.coding.where(system = 'http://loinc.org')` with unset `column.type`, returning a serialized Coding object as text instead of reporting the required non-primitive type error. The same expression declared as `type: string` also bypassed primitive mismatch reporting.
issues.root_cause: SQLGenerator applied full runtime type checks only to simple FHIRPath navigation paths. Non-simple expressions still got collection cardinality checks but could serialize complex JSON object/array results through `fhirpath_text()` when `column.type` was unset or primitive-declared.
issues.resolution: Added a narrow runtime complex-result guard for non-simple expressions. Simple paths retain full `type().name` validation; non-simple paths now reject physically complex JSON object/array values when runtime type names are absent or incompatible with unset/declared column type, while preserving primitive function outputs.
